name: arbitrage-platform
description: Foundation monorepo for the multi-exchange analytics platform.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@arbitrage/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@arbitrage/market-data && npm run build --workspace=@arbitrage/okx-public-adapter && npm run build --workspace=@arbitrage/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@arbitrage/contracts && npm run lint --workspace=@arbitrage/market-data && npm run lint --workspace=@arbitrage/okx-public-adapter && npm run lint --workspace=@arbitrage/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@arbitrage/contracts && npm run test --workspace=@arbitrage/market-data && npm run test --workspace=@arbitrage/okx-public-adapter && npm run test --workspace=@arbitrage/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@arbitrage/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=@arbitrage/market-data && npm run typecheck --workspace=@arbitrage/okx-public-adapter && npm run typecheck --workspace=@arbitrage/web
